fileOffset.description: File offset; null in zero fill or outside the file.

export.description: The export at the address, or the nearest before it as name+0xN.

lines.description: Everything the text says, line by line.

function.description: Containing function as name+0xN (code index built).

status.description: decoded, mid_instruction, data, not_in_function, unmapped, outside_image or invalid (x86 / x64, code index built).

containingInstruction.description: mid_instruction: the instruction covering the address.

dataItem.description: The data item covering the address, as kind: text.

referencesTo.description: Cross-references to the address by kind.

more.description: With addresses: the records of the others, in order; a failed one has empty Rva and its error as Lines.
